courses.title: Basic Computer & Internet Literacy
courses.prereq: None — designed for absolute first-time users.
courses.bestFor: Seniors, homemakers, and Tier-2/3 learners entering the digital economy.
courses.brief: File management, browsers, email, safe internet use, and government/UPI portals.
learn: Computer parts, operating a Windows PC, keyboard & mouse basics
Files & folders — create, rename, copy, move, search, and back up
Web browsers — searching, tabs, bookmarks, downloads, and clearing history
Email — creating an account, composing, attachments, spam, and etiquette
Everyday government & utility portals — DigiLocker, UPI apps, online bill payment
Staying safe — recognising scams, strong passwords, and privacy basics
courses.handsOn: Set up an email account, send an email with an attachment, and complete a mock UPI payment.
courses.outcome: Confidently use a computer and the internet for daily life; ready for Basic Excel or Google Workspace.

courses.title: Basic Microsoft Excel
courses.bestFor: Anyone entering an office/data role — the most-requested office skill in India.
courses.brief: Cells, formulas, IF, sorting, filtering and charts, with a working spreadsheet lab in every module.
learn: Workbooks, cells, ranges and clean formatting
Formulas, cell references and the dollar sign
SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT and ROUND
IF, AND, OR, COUNTIF and SUMIF for decisions
Sorting and filtering without breaking rows
Choosing, building and checking charts
courses.handsOn: Build a monthly shop report with totals, a target check, category summaries and a chart.
courses.outcome: Handle everyday spreadsheets at work or in study with confidence.

courses.title: Advanced Excel
courses.bestFor: Analysts, accountants, and managers who work in spreadsheets daily.
courses.brief: Pivot tables, lookups, and dashboards for analysts and managers.
learn: PivotTables & PivotCharts — grouping, slicers, and calculated fields
Lookup functions — VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, HLOOKUP
Logical & text functions — nested IF, IFS, CONCAT, TEXT, LEFT/RIGHT/MID
Conditional formatting and data validation (dropdowns)
What-if analysis — Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, Data Tables
Building an interactive dashboard with charts and controls
courses.handsOn: Create a sales dashboard from raw transaction data with slicers and KPIs.
courses.outcome: Do real reporting/analysis; next step Excel Macros & VBA or Power BI.

courses.title: Excel Automation with Macros & VBA
courses.prereq: Advanced Excel; some comfort with formulas.
courses.bestFor: Finance/operations staff who repeat the same reports every week.
courses.brief: Recording macros and writing VBA to automate repetitive reporting.
learn: Recording, editing, and running macros; the Developer tab
The VBA editor, modules, and the object model (Workbook/Worksheet/Range)
Variables, loops (For/Do), and conditionals (If/Select Case)
Automating formatting, data cleanup, and multi-sheet consolidation
Building custom functions (UDFs) and simple UserForms
Error handling and scheduling/triggering macros
courses.handsOn: Build a one-click macro that imports data, cleans it, and generates a formatted report.
courses.outcome: Automate hours of manual work; a strong resume differentiator.

courses.title: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms)
courses.bestFor: Students, startups, and remote teams that collaborate online.
courses.brief: Cloud collaboration and Forms surveys.
learn: Google Drive — storage, sharing, permissions, and version history
Docs — collaborative writing, comments, suggestions, and templates
Sheets — formulas, sharing, and basic charts (with Excel differences)
Slides — quick decks and real-time co-editing
Forms — building surveys/quizzes and reading responses in Sheets
Google Meet & Calendar basics for team coordination
courses.handsOn: Run a live feedback survey with Forms and auto-summarise responses in Sheets.
courses.outcome: Collaborate smoothly in any modern workplace.

courses.title: Microsoft Word — Professional Documents
courses.bestFor: Anyone creating resumes, reports, and business documents.
courses.brief: Formatting, structure, tables, letters, résumés and reports, with a document lab in every module.
learn: Editing quickly: selecting, shortcuts, find and replace
Fonts, spacing, alignment and lists
Heading styles, page setup, headers and page numbers
Tables, pictures, captions and breaks
Letters, résumés, reports and meeting minutes
Proofreading, track changes, accessibility and PDF export
courses.handsOn: Write a one-page report with headings, a table, a list and a recommendation.
courses.outcome: Produce clear, professional documents for school or work.

courses.title: PowerPoint & Presentation Design
courses.bestFor: Students and professionals who pitch, report, or teach.
courses.brief: Plan the message, design clean slides, use visuals honestly and deliver with confidence.
learn: Audience, purpose, core message and storyboarding
Layouts, themes and consistency
Headlines, readable text and speaker notes
Diagrams, shapes and honest charts
Openings, signposts, rehearsal and questions
Review checklists, accessibility and online delivery
courses.handsOn: Build and rehearse a seven-to-nine-slide talk with a diagram and a clear request.
courses.outcome: Present with clarity and confidence at school, college or work.

courses.title: Data Analytics with Python & SQL
courses.prereq: Basic Excel and comfort with computers; no coding needed to start.
courses.bestFor: Career-starters targeting analyst roles in IT, BFSI, e-commerce, consulting.
courses.brief: The flagship path — Excel to SQL to Python to BI dashboards.
learn: The analytics workflow — question, data, clean, analyse, present
SQL — SELECT, joins, GROUP BY, subqueries, and window functions
Python for data — Pandas for cleaning, merging, and aggregation; NumPy basics
Exploratory data analysis and descriptive statistics
Charting with Matplotlib/Seaborn and dashboarding in Power BI/Tableau
Data storytelling — turning findings into recommendations
courses.handsOn: End-to-end capstone — pull data with SQL, analyse in Python, present a dashboard.
courses.outcome: Target Data Analyst / Business Analyst roles; next step Data Engineering or Machine Learning.

courses.title: SQL for Data & Business
courses.bestFor: Analysts, PMs, marketers — anyone who needs to pull their own data.
courses.brief: The universal data language every analyst and PM needs.
learn: Databases, tables, and the SELECT statement
Filtering (WHERE), sorting (ORDER BY), and DISTINCT
Aggregations — COUNT, SUM, AVG with GROUP BY and HAVING
Joins — INNER, LEFT/RIGHT, and self-joins
Subqueries, CTEs, and window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK)
Data types, NULL handling, and query optimisation basics
courses.handsOn: Answer 10 business questions from a sample e-commerce database.
courses.outcome: Query any database confidently; feeds Data Analytics and Power BI.

courses.title: Business Analytics with Power BI
courses.prereq: Excel basics; SQL helpful but not required.
courses.bestFor: Professionals in product, operations, finance, and consulting.
courses.brief: Data models, DAX, and interactive dashboards.
learn: Connecting and transforming data with Power Query
Data modelling — relationships, star schema, and normalisation
DAX — measures, calculated columns, and time-intelligence
Visuals — charts, cards, maps, slicers, and drill-through
Dashboard design, bookmarks, and interactivity
Publishing to the Power BI Service and scheduled refresh
courses.handsOn: Build and publish an interactive sales-and-operations dashboard.
courses.outcome: Build reports leaders rely on; a high-demand standalone skill.

courses.title: Data Visualization with Tableau
courses.bestFor: Analysts and anyone presenting data to decision-makers.
courses.brief: Turning raw data into clear, decision-ready dashboards and stories.
learn: Connecting data sources and understanding dimensions vs measures
Core chart types and when to use each
Calculated fields, parameters, and table calculations
Filters, groups, sets, and hierarchies
Dashboards, actions, and story points
Visual best practice — colour, labels, and avoiding chart junk
courses.handsOn: Create a multi-view dashboard and a guided data story.
courses.outcome: Communicate data visually; complements Power BI.

courses.title: Advanced Excel for Data Analysis
courses.bestFor: Analysts who prefer to stay in Excel before moving to BI tools.
courses.brief: Power Query, Power Pivot, and statistics for spreadsheet analysts.
learn: Power Query — importing, cleaning, and transforming data
Power Pivot and the data model with relationships
Intro to DAX measures inside Excel
Statistical functions — regression, correlation, forecasting
Advanced lookups, array formulas, and dynamic arrays (FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE)
Interactive dashboards with slicers and timelines
courses.handsOn: Build a self-refreshing analytics workbook from multiple data files.
courses.outcome: Do serious analysis without leaving Excel; natural bridge to Power BI.

courses.title: Statistics for Analysts & Data Science
courses.bestFor: Aspiring data analysts/scientists who want trustworthy results.
courses.brief: Describe data, measure spread, read distributions, work with probability, estimate with confidence intervals and test relationships.
learn: Data types and the right average for the situation
Variance, standard deviation and z-scores
Frequency tables, histograms and the normal curve
Probability rules, conditional probability and expected value
Sampling, bias, standard error and confidence intervals
Correlation, regression and the logic of significance tests
courses.handsOn: Analyse a small survey end to end in a spreadsheet and report the findings honestly.
courses.outcome: Summarise data, quantify uncertainty and judge claims about relationships with care.

courses.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
courses.bestFor: Analysts/developers moving into high-paying data-engineering roles.
courses.brief: Pipelines, ETL/ELT, warehouses, and Spark — a fast-rising 2026 specialization.

Batch vs streaming and the ETL/ELT paradigm
Building pipelines and orchestration (Airflow concepts)
Distributed processing with Apache Spark
Working with cloud warehouses (BigQuery/Redshift/Snowflake concepts)
Data quality, partitioning, and cost/performance basics

courses.outcome: Target Data Engineer roles with a strong salary premium.

courses.title: Google Analytics 4 & Web Analytics
courses.bestFor: Marketers, founders, and product folks measuring digital growth.
courses.brief: Event tracking, funnels, and attribution to measure and grow digital products.

Setting up properties, data streams, and events
Key reports — acquisition, engagement, retention, monetization
Conversions, funnels, and exploration reports
Audiences, segments, and attribution models

courses.title: AI Literacy & Everyday Productivity

courses.brief: How assistants work, prompt structure, techniques, testing, safe use and a personal prompt library.

A prompt template: role, task, context, constraints, format
Few-shot examples, step-by-step reasoning and output formats
Testing prompts with rubrics and estimating cost
Privacy, honesty, bias and responsible use
Using AI for writing, study and work

courses.outcome: Write clear prompts, test and improve them and use AI assistants responsibly.

Model evaluation — accuracy, precision/recall, ROC, cross-validation
scikit-learn pipelines and avoiding overfitting

Transformers and the attention mechanism
Regularisation, dropout, and transfer learning
Building and training models in PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras

Deploying a vision model to an app or edge device
